  [Life Sciences]
  
  Not sure what you're looking for?
  
  [Start with our Life Sciences overview][188]
  **Real-World Data**
  [NLP-Enriched EHR Data Solutions][189] Large-scale, high-quality health data sets.
  **Real-World Evidence**
  [Real-World Evidence][190] Retrospective and prospective research by RWE experts.
  [Real-World Evidence Analytics Platform][191] SaaS application enabling efficient analysis of
  real-world data.
  **Point of Care Marketing**
  [Digital Health Media][192] Highly targeted brand awareness messaging in the EHR.*
* [Health Plans + Payers][193]
  [Health Plan Payers]
  
  Not sure what you're looking for?
  
  [Start with our Health Plans + Payers overview][194]
  **Gap Closure**
  [Gap Closure Services][195] Proactive, clinically-driven services to help health plans and their
  network providers close care gaps.
  [Care Gap Alerting][196] Point-of-care care gap alerting.
  [Provider Engagement Solutions][197] Streamlined payer-provider collaboration for better gap
  closure.
  **Risk Adjustment**
  [Health Equity Analytics][198] Go beyond Social Determinants of Health (SDoH).
  [Risk Adjustment Analytics][199] Analytics to find and prioritize gaps and opportunities.
  [Risk Mitigator][200] RADV audits - be prepared, not scared.
  [Comprehensive Submissions][201] One cloud-based data management platform for all government
  programs.
  [Utilization Analytics][202] Delivers visibility needed to monitor and manage key performance
  indicators.
  **Data Exchange + Coding**
  [eChart Courier][203] Automated electronic chart retrieval.
  [eChart Coder][204] Boost productivity and reduce costs with Veradigm eChart Coder.
  [eChart Integration and Analytics][205] Automated exchange of clinical data and medical record
  information for analysis.
  **Quality Management**
  [Quality Analytics][206] Proven analytic solution to help plans enhance Quality performance across
  their member base.
  [Risk Adjustment and Quality Management][207] Real-time visibility to monitor and manage your KPIs
  for risk and quality alike.
  **Clearinghouse + EDI**
  [Veradigm Payerpath][208] Claims and risk adjustment solution including an effective collaboration
  delivering streamlined EDI.
* [Healthcare Providers][209]
  [Healthcare Provider]
  
  Not sure what you're looking for?
  
  [Start with our Healthcare Providers overview][210]
  **Our Platform**
  [Veradigm Suite][211] Explore Veradigm’s powerful healthcare solutions designed to streamline
  operations, improve patient care, and boost practice efficiency.
  **Streamline Practice Operations**
  [Practice Management][212] Simplified software for effortless scheduling, billing, and claims
  processing.
  [AI Patient Scheduling][213] Automate and optimize patient scheduling with artificial
  intelligence.
  **Improve Clinical Efficiency**
  [EHR Software][214] Adaptable ambulatory EHR platform that supports your clinical documentation
  and workflow needs.
  [ePrescribe][215] Affordable and certified e-Prescribing solution including controlled substances.
  [Gap Closure Alerting][216] Point-of-care care gap alerting.
  [Clinical Data Registries][217] Registry participation for providers.
  [eChart Courier][218] Save time, reduce costs, and increase efficiency by automating medical chart
  retrieval.
  **Maximize Revenue**
  [Revenue Cycle Services][219] Let us handle billing, minimize denials, enhance coding, and ensure
  timely payments.
  [Coding Services][220] Get help to reduce staff burden and increase revenue - let our team manage
  coding for you.
  [Veradigm Payerpath][221] All-in-one revenue cycle management solution that features a top-tier
  clearinghouse.
  [Veradigm Intelligent Payments][222] Simplify patient billing and boost collections with
  intelligent, automated payments.
  **Engage Patients**
  [Patient Engagement Platform][223] Integrate with a mobile-first patient engagement platform.
  **Optimize Resources and Spend**
  [ERP Fiscal Management][224] Automate finance workflows and improve visibility into spend,
  reporting, and compliance.
  [ERP Point of Use][225] Track supply usage in clinical settings to reduce waste and improve
  accuracy.
  [ERP Supply Chain][226] Streamline purchasing and inventory with real-time visibility from
  requisition to delivery.
* [Health IT Vendors][227]
  [Veradigm Network]
  
  Not sure what you're looking for?
  
  [Start with our Healthcare IT Vendor Solutions overview][228]
  **Powered by the Network**
  [Life Sciences][229] Empowering life science with trusted data and insights from the point of
  care.
  [Health Plans + Payers][230] Connecting payers to the Veradigm Network’s comprehensive, national
  provider footprint.
  [Providers][231] Integrated clinical & financial solutions for a healthier practice.
  **API Connectivity**
  [Veradigm Connect][232] Connect the latest health tech solutions with the physicians and patients
  who need them.
  [App Expo][233] Become one of hundreds of certified applications and devices for provider
  practices built on open APIs.
  [Diagnostic Ordering and Results Network (DORN)][234] Connecting EHR Vendors with Lab and
  Radiology centers.
  **Electronic Prescribing**
  [Veradigm ePrescribe Enterprise][235] Integrated, advanced, easy-to-use ePrescribing for EHR and
  HIT vendors.
* [Insights][236]
  [Two hands typing on a laptop]
  
  Not sure what you're looking for?
  
  [Filter through all of Veradigm's Insights][237]
  **Veradigm Insights**
  [Blog Posts][238] Read through our collection of valuable insights.
  [Videos][239] Watch our videos to learn more about our offerings.
  [Thought Leadership][240] Read the latest healthcare insights from our team of subject matter
  experts.
  [Podcasts][241] Listen to our podcasts to hear healthcare insights from our team of experts.
  [Webinars][242] Watch our webinars to learn more about how we are transforming health,
  insightfully.
  **Resources**
  [RWE Publications][243] Read through our RWE publications and learn how we help clients.
  [Clinical Data Registries][244] Explore our registry publications and learn how we help clients.
  [*Smart Medicine* Podcast][245] Thought-provoking podcast dedicated to understanding the
  intersection of care and innovation
  **Trending Topics**
  [Value-Based Care][246] Comprehensive guide to value-based care, including use cases, relevant
  blog articles, white papers and more.
  [Real-World Evidence][247] Complete overview of real-world evidence, why it’s important, and how
  it’s used in healthcare.
  [Real-World Data][248] Thorough review of what real-world healthcare data is, how it’s collected,
  and how it’s used across the healthcare spectrum.
  [Payer Provider Relationships Guide][249] Discover the impact of payer-provider relationships on
  healthcare. Learn how collaboration improves patient care and addresses challenges.

# With the Patient at the Heart

We develop software that helps people get well, helps people stay well, and helps future generations
be healthier.
[Our story →][1]

## Nurses Save Time and Keep Families Connected Using AI

At UNC Health, Riverside Health, and WakeMed, nurses reduce documentation time and improve patient &
family communication with the help of Art, Epic’s AI for clinicians.
[Learn more →][2]

## Teamwork Staff Scheduling Delivers Faster Care Coordination and Reduces Administrative Work at
## Health Systems Worldwide

Organizations report on the benefits of Teamwork—the first application in EpicOps, Epic’s integrated
Enterprise Resource Planning suite built for healthcare.
[Learn more →][3]

## UnityPoint Health Saves Lives with Better Sepsis Detection and Treatment in Pregnancy

Detection criteria and care path built into Epic EHR help clinicians identify sepsis in maternal
patients sooner and reduce time to treatment.
[Learn more →][4]

Alongside healthcare providers, Epic is taking legal action to defend patient privacy.
[Read more →][5]

# Our Software

Our software makes it possible for every patient to have a single, comprehensive medical record that
informs and is informed by their health experiences. The goal is higher-quality, more personalized
care that's simpler for patients, medical professionals, and everyone who makes healthcare happen.
[Learn more about our software →][6]

## Share What You've Done, Learn What You Can Do

Explore more on
[EpicShare]

Communication]

### From Phone Tag to Push Notifications: How Four Health Systems Closed the Loop on Critical Lab
### Communication

July 06, 2026
Four health systems are among those that have replaced phone calls for critical lab result
communication with Epic push notifications, achieving acknowledgement times under one
minute—compared to an average of seven to twelve minutes previously. Lab staff save approximately
ten minutes per result, which adds up to enough time saved at one organization for 15 full-time
staff members to focus on higher-value work. Clinicians acted faster on critical results, where
every minute matters.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][8]
[Providing Pain Relief for Sickle Cell Crises Faster with Personal, Portable Care Plans]

### Providing Pain Relief for Sickle Cell Crises Faster with Personal, Portable Care Plans

June 22, 2026
Manchester University NHS Foundation Trust developed a digital sickle cell care program to improve
tracking and transparency of emergency pain management. The program includes personalized emergency
care plans and an ED order set. Patients went from having no digital care plans to 89% coverage, and
active patient portal usage among people with sickle cell disease increased from 43% to 58%.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][9]
[Using Telecritical Care to Reduce ICU Mortality]

### Using Telecritical Care to Reduce ICU Mortality

June 15, 2026
To provide expert overnight critical care, Kaiser Permanente Northern California implemented a
telecritical care program that connects remote intensivists and nurses to ICUs through real-time
monitoring, camera feeds, and instant communication. Today, the program is in use across 18 ICUs and
is associated with a 7% reduction in adjusted mortality.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][10]
[AI Coding Assistant Reduces Chart Review Time by 20%, Freeing Coders for Higher-Value Work]

### AI Coding Assistant Reduces Chart Review Time by 20%, Freeing Coders for Higher-Value Work

June 08, 2026
After implementing Epic’s AI Professional Billing Coding Assistant, coders at Baptist Health in
Jacksonville, Florida spend 20% less time reviewing charts—an estimated $924,000 in annual labor
savings. Clean claim rates and coder productivity have also improved.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][11]

  * [Pharmaceutical, Medical Supplies & Products Distribution Services][53]
    
    We distribute pharmaceuticals and medical supplies to healthcare settings across North America,
    from pharmacies and hospitals to doctors’ offices and clinics.
    * [Pharmaceutical Distribution Services][54]
    * [Medical Supply Distribution][55]
  * [Pharmacy Services][56]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.
  * [Oncology & Multispecialty Solutions][57]
    
    We provide research, insights, technologies and other support to help address challenges in
    cancer and specialty care.
  * [Biopharma Capabilities][58]
    
    We provide a suite of solutions designed to address access, affordability and adherence
    challenges by bridging the gaps between biopharma companies, pharmacies, providers, and payers
    to help patients get on and stay on their medications.
  * [Prescription Benefit Solutions][59]
    
    We offer solutions that enable employers, payers, health-plan brokers and government agencies to
    provide lower-cost options for prescription medications and therapies.
  * [Consumer Products & Services][60]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]
[Person in a blue McKesson-branded jacket with arms crossed, standing in an industrial or warehouse
setting.]

[Two scientists in a laboratory, one standing and reading a tablet, the other sitting and working at

### [ Biopharma Capabilities ][130]

[A person in a yellow shirt and gray cardigan holds a smartphone and a pill bottle, with a child in
the background.]

### [ Prescription Benefit Solutions ][131]

[Person sitting on the floor in a living room, wrapping a bandage around their elbow. A yellow
ottoman and a glass of water are in the background.]

### [ Consumer Products & Services ][132]

[Worker pulls pallet jack quickly through a warehouse aisle, shelves lined with boxes, motion blur
emphasizing fast movement.]
Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

What We Do

## Comprehensive Systems Integration

From architecture and deployment to ongoing optimization, we deliver end-to-end technology solutions
that align with your business objectives.

🖥

### Computer Systems Design

Custom infrastructure blueprints engineered for performance, redundancy, and cost efficiency. We
assess your workloads and architect systems that scale with your business.

🌐

### Network Architecture

Secure, high-throughput network designs spanning LAN, WAN, SD-WAN, and wireless. Every topology is
documented, tested, and optimized for zero-downtime operation.

☁

### Cloud Migration & Hybrid

Seamless transitions to AWS, Azure, or private cloud environments. We handle workload assessment,
data migration, and post-migration validation with minimal disruption.

🛡

### Cybersecurity Hardening

Multi-layered defense strategies including endpoint protection, intrusion detection, SIEM
integration, and compliance-ready audit trails for regulated industries.

📈

### Managed IT Operations

24/7 monitoring, patch management, backup orchestration, and help desk escalation. Proactive
maintenance that prevents outages before they impact your users.

🔧

### System Integration & API

Connecting disparate platforms through custom middleware, RESTful APIs, and message queues. Unified
data flows that eliminate manual reconciliation and siloed reporting.

Who We Serve

## Industries We Power

Specialized expertise across regulated, high-availability, and data-intensive sectors where system
reliability is non-negotiable.

#### Healthcare & Life Sciences

HIPAA-compliant infrastructure, EHR integration, and secure telemedicine platforms designed for
clinical workflows and patient data protection.

#### Financial Services & Fintech

Low-latency trading infrastructure, PCI-DSS compliant payment systems, and SOC 2-ready architectures
for banking, insurance, and investment platforms.

#### Logistics & Supply Chain

Real-time inventory tracking, warehouse management system integration, and route optimization
engines that reduce operating costs and improve delivery SLAs.

#### Professional Services

Document management systems, CRM deployments, and unified communications platforms for legal,
accounting, and consulting firms with demanding confidentiality requirements.

#### Manufacturing & Industrial

SCADA integration, IoT sensor networks, and predictive maintenance dashboards connecting factory
floors to executive visibility in real time.

#### Retail & E-Commerce

Omnichannel POS integration, inventory synchronization, and CDN-accelerated storefronts engineered
for Black Friday-scale traffic without performance degradation.

About Us

## Engineering Reliability Into Every System

BG HANDYMAN LLC was founded on a single conviction: technology infrastructure should be a growth
accelerator, not a recurring headache. Headquartered in Tampa, Florida, we serve organizations
across the United States that depend on their systems being available, secure, and cost-effective.

Our team combines deep expertise in systems engineering, network design, and cloud architecture with
a practical, outcomes-driven approach. We do not believe in one-size-fits-all solutions. Every
engagement begins with understanding your operational requirements, compliance obligations, and
growth trajectory.

What sets us apart is our integration-first philosophy. Rather than patching together incompatible
tools, we design holistic ecosystems where your hardware, software, and cloud services operate as a
unified platform, reducing complexity and lowering total cost of ownership.

### Flexible, Scalable & Secure
### Enterprise AI Solutions

Blackford are pioneers in the healthcare AI space, with over a decade of experience working in
partnership with leading hospitals and ground-breaking healthcare technology providers.

We partner with you to cut through the complexity, leveraging our years of experience to simplify AI
adoption across the Healthcare Enterprise, ensuring that you deploy the right AI at the right time
to enable quicker decisions, drive efficiencies and return on investment.

Blackford’s is trusted by leading healthcare providers and industry partners all around the world.
Our proven AI Platform and portfolio of 130+ AI applications sits at the center of an Enterprise
solution that integrates seamlessly within your existing workflow and across your imaging
informatics systems, providing the security, flexibility and access to AI where and when you need
it.

Our team of clinicians, informaticists and technical AI experts are there to provide the services
and support you need to tailor AI solutions specifically to your needs, ensuring your AI strategy
delivers measurable ongoing value and improved outcomes across your health system, now and in the
future.

### Flexible, Scalable & Secure
### Enterprise AI Solutions

Blackford are pioneers in the healthcare AI space, with over a decade of experience working in
partnership with leading hospitals and ground-breaking healthcare technology providers.

We partner with you to cut through the complexity, leveraging our years of experience to simplify AI
adoption across the Healthcare Enterprise, ensuring that you deploy the right AI at the right time
to enable quicker decisions, drive efficiencies and return on investment.

Blackford’s is trusted by leading healthcare providers and industry partners all around the world.
Our proven AI Platform and portfolio of 130+ AI applications sits at the center of an Enterprise
solution that integrates seamlessly within your existing workflow and across your imaging
informatics systems, providing the security, flexibility and access to AI where and when you need
it.

Our team of clinicians, informaticists and technical AI experts are there to provide the services
and support you need to tailor AI solutions specifically to your needs, ensuring your AI strategy
delivers measurable ongoing value and improved outcomes across your health system, now and in the
future.

A persona-based platform for secure application access, managed services, and

### **Healthcare IT solutions**

With over 4,300 healthcare customers worldwide, Citrix is the leader in delivering secure, scalable,
and resilient solutions to healthcare customers for over 3 decades.

[Read more on Citrix healthcare solutions][75]

With the Citrix platform, financial services institutions including banks, brokerages, investment
firms, and insurance companies can provide employees and customers with instant secure access to
apps and data on any device.

[Read more on Citrix financial services solutions][76]

cloud-based management portal, regardless of whether they are running on a government-grade cloud
offering or your on-premises environments.

[Read more][79]

access for SaaS and web applications

# About Clinical Workflow Solutions LLC

At Clinical Workflow Solutions, we believe healthcare works best when technology supports people—not
the other way around.

Our company was founded on a simple idea: healthcare providers should spend more time caring for
patients and less time struggling with inefficient processes, administrative burdens, and technology
challenges.

With decades of experience working alongside physicians, nurses, clinical staff, and healthcare
leaders, we understand the daily pressures healthcare organizations face. We recognize that
successful technology adoption is not just about implementing systems—it is about creating workflows
that support caregivers, improve efficiency, and enhance the patient experience.

We partner with healthcare organizations to optimize clinical operations, strengthen technology
adoption, and deliver measurable improvements in performance. Rather than offering one-size-fits-all
solutions, we take the time to understand your unique goals, challenges, and workflows. The result
is practical, sustainable solutions that improve outcomes for providers, staff, and patients alike.

To help healthcare organizations maximize the value of their people, processes, and technology

operational excellence.

To be the trusted partner healthcare organizations turn to for workflow excellence, provider
empowerment, and technology optimization—creating a future where clinicians spend more time caring
for patients and less time managing systems.

### Workflow Assessment & Optimization

We evaluate current-state workflows using Epic Signal data to identify inefficiencies, reduce
unnecessary administrative burden, and design streamlined processes that improve productivity and
patient care.

### Electronic Health Record (EHR) Implementation & Support

We provide expert guidance throughout the implementation lifecycle, helping organizations
successfully deploy, optimize, and support their EHR systems.

### Provider & Staff Training

Effective training is essential for long-term success. We develop and deliver customized training
programs that increase user confidence, improve adoption, and promote best practices.

### Personalization & Adoption Strategies

Technology works best when it works for the individual user. We help providers and staff personalize
their workflows and leverage available tools to improve efficiency and satisfaction.

### Change Management & Operational Readiness

Organizational change can be challenging. We help healthcare teams prepare for change, engage
stakeholders, and build readiness strategies that support successful transitions.

### Performance Improvement Initiatives

Our data-driven approach helps organizations identify opportunities for improvement, measure
success, and sustain positive results over time.

Meet Our Founder

**Founder | Epic Consultant | Principal Trainer | Clinical Workflow Specialist**

Peggy L. Conner is the founder of Clinical Workflow Solutions and brings more than two decades of
healthcare information technology, clinical workflow optimization, and Epic training experience to
healthcare organizations across the nation.

Her passion for helping providers succeed with technology has been the driving force behind a career
dedicated to improving clinical workflows, increasing user adoption, and enhancing patient care
through effective use of electronic health records.

A California resident since 1981, Peggy relocated from Michigan to pursue opportunities in the
rapidly growing field of Information Services. She began her professional career with CompuCorp in
Santa Monica, California, where her technical expertise and strong communication skills quickly
distinguished her as a rising leader. Early in her career, she was selected for a prestigious
assignment in Washington, D.C., serving as a Marketing Support Representative providing on-site
technical support and system training to high-profile clients, including the Superior Courts and the
White House.

Peggy’s healthcare technology journey expanded significantly in 2007 when she earned her Epic
Ambulatory Certification from Epic Systems in Madison, Wisconsin while serving as an Epic Ambulatory
Analyst at UC San Diego Health. During a critical period of electronic health record implementation,
she played an instrumental role in configuring workflows, supporting clinical operations, and
training providers and staff on the effective use of Epic.

Recognizing her unique ability to bridge the gap between technology and patient care, Peggy entered
the healthcare consulting arena in 2009. Over the years, she has worked with some of the nation’s
most respected healthcare organizations, providing Epic training, workflow consulting, and
implementation support for physicians, nurses, and clinical teams. Her consulting experience
includes engagements with leading healthcare institutions such as NewYork-Presbyterian Hospital,
Texas Children’s Hospital, Group Health Cooperative, Allegheny Health Network, and the Sisters of
St. Mary Health System, among many others.

In 2017, Peggy returned to Southern California to support the implementation of Epic at UC Irvine
Health. As a consultant, she helped design and deliver comprehensive training programs for providers
and nursing staff during the organization’s Epic rollout. Her leadership, expertise, and commitment
to user success led to her recruitment as a full-time Principal Trainer in 2019, where she
specialized in Epic Ambulatory training and provider adoption strategies.

Today, through Clinical Workflow Solutions, Peggy combines decades of hands-on healthcare IT
experience with a deep understanding of clinical operations to help healthcare organizations improve
efficiency, optimize workflows, strengthen provider satisfaction, and maximize the value of their
technology investments.

Peggy’s approach is built on a simple philosophy: technology should support caregivers, not burden
them. By focusing on practical solutions, personalized training, workflow optimization, and
sustainable adoption strategies, she helps organizations create meaningful improvements that benefit
providers, staff, and patients alike.

successful technology adoption is not just about implementing systems—it is about creating workflows
that support caregivers, improve efficiency, and enhance the patient experience.

We partner with healthcare organizations to optimize clinical operations, strengthen technology
adoption, and deliver measurable improvements in performance. Rather than offering one-size-fits-all
solutions, we take the time to understand your unique goals, challenges, and workflows. The result
is practical, sustainable solutions that improve outcomes for providers, staff, and patients alike.

### Our Mission

To help healthcare organizations maximize the value of their people, processes, and technology
through workflow optimization, education, and strategic guidance that enhances patient care and
operational excellence.

### Our Vision

To be the trusted partner healthcare organizations turn to for workflow excellence, provider
empowerment, and technology optimization—creating a future where clinicians spend more time caring
for patients and less time managing systems.

## Our Services

### Workflow Assessment & Optimization

We evaluate current-state workflows using Epic Signal data to identify inefficiencies, reduce
unnecessary administrative burden, and design streamlined processes that improve productivity and
patient care.

### Electronic Health Record (EHR) Implementation & Support

We provide expert guidance throughout the implementation lifecycle, helping organizations
successfully deploy, optimize, and support their EHR systems.

### Provider & Staff Training

Effective training is essential for long-term success. We develop and deliver customized training
programs that increase user confidence, improve adoption, and promote best practices.

### Personalization & Adoption Strategies

Technology works best when it works for the individual user. We help providers and staff personalize
their workflows and leverage available tools to improve efficiency and satisfaction.

### Change Management & Operational Readiness

Organizational change can be challenging. We help healthcare teams prepare for change, engage
stakeholders, and build readiness strategies that support successful transitions.

### Performance Improvement Initiatives

Our data-driven approach helps organizations identify opportunities for improvement, measure
success, and sustain positive results over time.

## Clinical Workflow Solutions specializes in helping organizations maximize the value of their Epic
## investment through strategic optimization initiatives.


Our services include:
• Epic workflow assessments and optimization
• Provider efficiency and personalization programs
• Epic Signal utilization and performance analysis
• Smart Tool adoption and optimization
• Smart Phrase and SmartText utilization strategies
• Documentation workflow improvement
• Provider coaching and one-on-one personalization sessions
• Training program development and enhancement
• Operational readiness planning
• Post-implementation optimization support

## **Why Partner with Clinical Workflow Solutions LLC**

Healthcare organizations today face growing demands to improve patient outcomes, increase provider
satisfaction, optimize operational performance, and maximize the return on technology investments.
At Clinical Workflow Solutions, we help healthcare organizations navigate these challenges by
delivering practical, experience-driven solutions that improve workflows, strengthen technology
adoption, and support exceptional patient care.

Meet Our Founder

**Founder | Epic Consultant | Principal Trainer | Clinical Workflow Specialist**

Peggy L. Conner is the founder of Clinical Workflow Solutions and brings more than two decades of
healthcare information technology, clinical workflow optimization, and Epic training experience to
healthcare organizations across the nation.

Her passion for helping providers succeed with technology has been the driving force behind a career
dedicated to improving clinical workflows, increasing user adoption, and enhancing patient care
through effective use of electronic health records.

A California resident since 1981, Peggy relocated from Michigan to pursue opportunities in the
rapidly growing field of Information Services. She began her professional career with CompuCorp in
Santa Monica, California, where her technical expertise and strong communication skills quickly
distinguished her as a rising leader. Early in her career, she was selected for a prestigious
assignment in Washington, D.C., serving as a Marketing Support Representative providing on-site
technical support and system training to high-profile clients, including the Superior Courts and the
White House.

Peggy’s healthcare technology journey expanded significantly in 2007 when she earned her Epic
Ambulatory Certification from Epic Systems in Madison, Wisconsin while serving as an Epic Ambulatory
Analyst at UC San Diego Health. During a critical period of electronic health record implementation,
she played an instrumental role in configuring workflows, supporting clinical operations, and
training providers and staff on the effective use of Epic.

Recognizing her unique ability to bridge the gap between technology and patient care, Peggy entered
the healthcare consulting arena in 2009. Over the years, she has worked with some of the nation’s
most respected healthcare organizations, providing Epic training, workflow consulting, and
implementation support for physicians, nurses, and clinical teams. Her consulting experience
includes engagements with leading healthcare institutions such as NewYork-Presbyterian Hospital,
Texas Children’s Hospital, Group Health Cooperative, Allegheny Health Network, and the Sisters of
St. Mary Health System, among many others.

In 2017, Peggy returned to Southern California to support the implementation of Epic at UC Irvine
Health. As a consultant, she helped design and deliver comprehensive training programs for providers
and nursing staff during the organization’s Epic rollout. Her leadership, expertise, and commitment
to user success led to her recruitment as a full-time Principal Trainer in 2019, where she
specialized in Epic Ambulatory training and provider adoption strategies.

Today, through Clinical Workflow Solutions, Peggy combines decades of hands-on healthcare IT
experience with a deep understanding of clinical operations to help healthcare organizations improve
efficiency, optimize workflows, strengthen provider satisfaction, and maximize the value of their
technology investments.

Peggy’s approach is built on a simple philosophy: technology should support caregivers, not burden
them. By focusing on practical solutions, personalized training, workflow optimization, and
sustainable adoption strategies, she helps organizations create meaningful improvements that benefit
providers, staff, and patients alike.

### Areas of Expertise
* Epic Ambulatory Training and Optimization
* Provider Personalization and Efficiency Programs
* Clinical Workflow Assessment and Improvement
* EHR Implementation and Adoption Strategies
* Change Management and Operational Readiness
* Provider and Staff Education
* Epic Signal Data Analysis
* Smart Tool Utilization and Optimization
* AI Ambient Documentation Adoption
* Performance Improvement Initiatives
* Epic Thrive Training

*“Helping healthcare organizations improve efficiency, strengthen technology adoption, and enhance
patient care—one workflow at a time.”*

# Contact Us

At Clinical Workflow Solutions, we view every client relationship as a partnership. We collaborate
closely with executive leadership, physicians, providers, nurses, clinical teams, operational
departments, and information technology staff to ensure solutions are practical, achievable, and
embraced throughout the organization.

***Your success becomes our success***!

# Welcome

# Decisions Advisors

Empowering global businesses through deep market intelligence.

### Who We Are?

**Decisions Advisors** is a comprehensive market research and consulting company that provides
actionable insights based on data. We deal with businesses from various industries and deliver a
market intelligence, competitive analysis, forecasting, and bespoke consulting. We also conduct
bespoke consulting for our clients.

The team at Decisions Advisors is proficient in a given industry and uses the latest research
techniques in the industry to provide guidance on informed decision making and also help in finding
expansion opportunities.The company provides well-supported advice and intelligence on how
businesses can operate in a given market and succeed in achieving their goals.

[About us ][25]

#### [Data-Driven Insights][26]

At Decisions Advisors, we strive to provide keen insights that motivate tangible action. Our mission
is to provide dependable solutions based on comprehensive analysis tailored to our clients’ evolving
demands. We integrate industry knowledge with a pragmatic approach to create research strategies
that address particular business challenges.

#### [Customized Research Solutions][27]

We develop customized research approaches based on your business objectives, providing actionable
insights that yield quantifiable outcomes, assist in strategic decision-making, and generate
sustainable value across shifting market environments.

#### [Industry Expertise][28]

With actionable insights across diverse sectors, our experts blend in-depth knowledge and sharp
analysis to decode intricate markets and grasp their underlying structures.

#### [Global Reach, Local Focus][29]

Provide insights that balance global perspective with local relevance, ensuring our research
captures both worldwide trends and the specific dynamics of regional markets for smarter decisions.

## Services

At Decisions Advisors, we offer a comprehensive suite of services designed to support your business
growth and strategic planning.

### [Market Intelligence][30]

Uncover trends, opportunities, and threats through in-depth market data and analysis.

### [Competitor Analysis][31]

Gain a competitive edge by understanding rivals’ strategies, strengths, and market positions.

### [Consumer Insights][32]

Decode customer behavior to craft targeted marketing, product, and engagement strategies.

### [Industry Forecasting][33]

Stay ahead with accurate projections and trend analysis for future planning.

# Better Clinical Decisions,
# Better Patient Care

#### EvidenceCare empowers *better care decisions* and *improved clinical and financial outcomes*
#### throughout the patient’s hospital stay.

[SCHEDULE A DEMO][21]

### Trusted by Top Health Systems

We understand hospital margins are tighter than ever. You need solutions that impact both cost and
care.

### *The BetterCare Platform™*

##### **Physician-Centered Solutions for Better Care and Stronger Margins**

Built to align clinical and financial goals, *The BetterCare Platform *optimizes clinical workflows,
improves hospital margins, and enhances care quality—both inside and outside the EHR—to deliver
5-10x ROI for health systems.

[ [admissioncare icon] ][22]

#### *AdmissionCare®*

Real-time bed status guidance and documentation

[ [caregauge icon] ][23]

#### *CareGauge®*

Real-time care utilization and cost of care data

[ [careinsights icon] ][24]

#### *CareInsights™*

Trusted clinical variation feedback via text

[careintelligence icon]

#### *CareIntelligence™*

Intelligent analytics for clear ROI and better care decisions

[GET A FULL PLATFORM DEMO][25]

##### *The Bottom Line*

## Health systems are facing a historic challenge.

Shortages, policy changes, and inefficiency plague clinical workforces, which puts more pressure on
already-thin margins for hospital administration.

Modern clinical decision technology needs to deliver both better care and financial ROI.

## 48

decline in hospital operating margins since the pandemic began.

## 500,000

clinical position deficits over the next decade.

## Doctors don't need more invasive technology.

**They need the right information at the right time.**

We believe health systems deserve clinicians thriving and operating at their best.

**When clinicians do their best work, patients receive the best care. **

*That’s why our clinical decision support software is different. *

Our products are designed with our end-users in mind that both optimize clinical workflows and
improve margins.

#### Thriving Physicians

#### Improved Care

#### Increased Margins

### Stop diminishing margins and inefficient clinical workflows...

Unlock a future of thriving physicians, higher-quality patient care, and better financial outcomes.

[SCHEDULE A DEMO][26]

#### with the latest healthcare digital innovation insights.

[LEARN MORE][27]

EvidenceCare offers an EHR-integrated platform that optimizes clinical workflows to deliver better
patient care, improve physicians’ workflow, capture more revenue, and reduce costs.

# See what your competitors
# will do next.

While others chase press releases and earnings calls, we capture real intelligence from the data
trails companies leave behind unknowingly — whether competitors, acquisition targets, potential
partners, or emerging disruptors.

Book a Demo
[Watch the Walkthrough][7]
[From digital exhaust to predictions]

## Trusted by teams at

[Intuit][S2A][Eleventh Hour Group][Abridge]
The Problem

## Why traditional intelligence falls short
* Curated narrativePress releases, earnings calls, official announcements — that's the story
  companies want you to see. By the time something is announced, it's too late to respond
  strategically. You're reacting, not planning.
* Commoditized sourcesTraditional market intelligence pulls from the same obvious sources everyone
  else uses. If you're reading it, so are your competitors.
* Data without contextTraditional tools bombard you with notifications — a job posting here, a doc
  update there. You spend hours trying to figure out what matters. You have alerts, not answers.

into a single forecast you can act on.

  patterns. We connect signals across sources — hiring spikes, doc changes, ad shifts, partnership
  chatter — to surface the combinations that actually mean something.
  Predictions
  Forecast
  Mid-market
  enterprise launch
  Hiring, product, and brand signals align one direction.
  Within 60 days
  High confidence
  PredictFrom the patterns, we forecast what's coming next — product launches, market entries,
  acquisitions, organizational pivots — each with a time horizon and confidence score. You see the

# **The smallest steps **can make the biggest impact.

FreeStyle Libre continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) systems let you see what affects your glucose so
you can achieve small, personal wins that can add up to progress. And can help you lower your
A1c^{[39][100],[27][101]}.
[ Discover Our Products ][102]
[ Sign Up Now ][103]
[a woman outdoors wearing a FreeStyle Libre sensor while stretching her leg on a park bench.]
[A yellow butterfly icon with a hole is cut into the bottom of the right wing of the butterfly to
serve as a portal.]

## **The #1 sensor worldwide^{[1][104]}.**

FreeStyle Libre systems continuously measure your glucose and helps you understand how food, sleep,
and exercise can affect your glucose. So, you can manage your diabetes with more
confidence^{[7][105]}.

## **New to continuous glucose monitoring (CGM)?
## Here’s how it works.**

FreeStyle Libre CGM systems are a painless^{[4][106]} way to see your glucose levels without finger
pricks^{[10][107]}. A small, discreet^{[2][108]} wearable sensor sends your glucose data to your
app^{[12][109]} or reader^{[213][110]} with accurate^{[2][111]} readings every minute.
[A close-up of the back of someone’s arm wearing a FreeStyle Libre sensor with an arrow pointing to
a phone displayng the FreeStyle Libre app.]

## **Daily glucose spike at lunchtime.
## See a pattern here?**

Wonder why your glucose dips at a certain time of day? Or what foods cause a spike? FreeStyle Libre
CGMs show you how meals, workouts, and medication can impact your glucose. These unique patterns can
help identify what you’re doing right and areas you can improve upon.
[ Get The Details ][112]
[ A healthy plate of pasta and marinara sauce. Above the plate is a phone showing a glucose spike on
the FreeStyle Libre app.]

## **Learn from others who have been there.**

[Yug Sharma]
[Graphic of the yellow brand butterfly.]

### "Earlier, I didn't have the energy to walk up a flight of stairs. With FreeStyle Libre, I can
### track and share my glucose levels, avoid low glucose and manage my energy levels. The best part
### is that my parents worry less."

[ Read Yug’s Story ][113]

## Frequently Asked Questions

[

View All FAQ's

][25]

What is Henry?

Henry is a telehealth service that makes it easy and affordable to get the medical care you need. We
help people manage weight loss, perimenopause and testosterone hormone therapies, and erectile
dysfunction, as well as other conditions. It’s easy to get started—just answer a few questions about
your health and lifestyle goals, and we’ll connect you with an expert provider. If medically
approved, you’ll get your prescribed medication by mail within a week. There’s no insurance
required. Just a simple monthly bill with your provider visits, medication and supplies, and ongoing
care included.

How does Henry work?

Henry makes it easy to get the personalized care you need in just a few steps. Answer a few
questions about your health and goals. A licensed healthcare provider will review your information
and recommend treatment if necessary. If prescribed, you’ll get your medication by mail within a few
days. There’s no insurance stress or surprise bills. Just one monthly payment that includes your
provider visit, medication and supplies, and ongoing care.

Who can use Henry?

Henry is open to all adults! To use Henry, you must: Be 18 years or older. Have a demonstrated
medical need for treatment. Live or have an address in one of the states we support.

How do I see a provider?

Click any “Get Started” button and answer a few questions about your health and lifestyle goals.
You’ll then be able to schedule a provider visit face-to-face with a video call, or depending on
your home state, choose an independent provider review without a video call. You and your provider
will be able to exchange messages through our secure patient portal.

Does Henry require a long-term contract?

No long-term contracts! Henry offers convenient monthly plans, as well as longer term plans for
certain treatments. You can easily cancel any time.

How soon will I receive my medication?

Most people receive their medication within 8-10 business days after they speak to their provider.
Just a heads up, people in California may experience longer fulfillment times because of additional
compound testing requirements.

What if I need to cancel?

You can cancel at any time in your account page of the patient portal, by contacting our support
team at ask@henrymeds.com, or by calling 909-787-2342. If you’re on a multi-month plan, you may be
required to pay out the rest of your balance unless you’re unable to continue for medical-related
reasons as determined by a healthcare provider.

What is compounded medication?

Compounded medication is prescription medicine from a licensed provider that’s custom-made by a
licensed pharmacist. Instead of a one-size-fits-all drug from big manufacturers, the pharmacist will
mix or adjust ingredients in compounded medication to tailor to your specific needs. Because these
medications are customized, they’re not FDA-approved in the same way as commercial drugs, but they
do use FDA-approved ingredients.

Do I need insurance?

No, you don’t need insurance! Henry makes it easy to get the care you need without having to deal
with insurance claims. Your provider visits, medication and supplies, shipping, and ongoing care are
all included in your plan price—without any hidden or surprise fees.

*If medically eligible

## FAQ

What cloud service providers do you support?

Kodjin FHIR software can be installed on all popular cloud providers: Amazon AWS, Google CP,
Microsoft Azure, or on any other cloud that supports the Kubernetes K8s platform.

Our FHIR integration software works seamlessly in cloud environments to connect and synchronize your
healthcare systems.

Is it possible to deploy Kodjin on-premise?

Yes. There’s only one technical requirement — the Kubernetes K8s platform should be deployed on your
infrastructure.

As an experienced FHIR vendor, we provide full support for both cloud-based and on-premise
deployments.

How much do your FHIR engineers’ services cost?

Contact us for a consultation and price for FHIR (Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources)
development services based on your project’s needs.

I want to implement HL7 FHIR for an EHR system. Can I integrate the EHR with your FHIR solutions?

The Kodjin FHIR Server can be integrated with EHR systems with native RESTful API or with a custom
ETL module or, finally, through FHIR Facade.

Does the Kodjin FHIR Server support horizontal scaling?

Yes. As Kodjin operates in a Kubernetes cluster, all stateless components could be horizontally
scaled.

Where can I learn more about FHIR?

You can learn more about FHIR in our [“What is FHIR®” guide][28].

## FAQ

What cloud service providers do you support?

Kodjin FHIR software can be installed on all popular cloud providers: Amazon AWS, Google CP,
Microsoft Azure, or on any other cloud that supports the Kubernetes K8s platform.

Our FHIR integration software works seamlessly in cloud environments to connect and synchronize your
healthcare systems.

Is it possible to deploy Kodjin on-premise?

Yes. There’s only one technical requirement — the Kubernetes K8s platform should be deployed on your
infrastructure.

As an experienced FHIR vendor, we provide full support for both cloud-based and on-premise
deployments.

How much do your FHIR engineers’ services cost?

Contact us for a consultation and price for FHIR (Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources)
development services based on your project’s needs.

I want to implement HL7 FHIR for an EHR system. Can I integrate the EHR with your FHIR solutions?

The Kodjin FHIR Server can be integrated with EHR systems with native RESTful API or with a custom
ETL module or, finally, through FHIR Facade.

Does the Kodjin FHIR Server support horizontal scaling?

Yes. As Kodjin operates in a Kubernetes cluster, all stateless components could be horizontally
scaled.

Where can I learn more about FHIR?

You can learn more about FHIR in our [“What is FHIR®” guide][28].

The only AI-powered clinical operations platform built by and for providers.

[Get started][100]
[Learn more][101]

MedFlow offers best-in-class integration with AthenaOne APIs and works with leading digital health
organizations.

# Serious impact. Fast.

Time to go-live
<7 days
With easy workflow templates, MedFlow automations within Athenahealth EHR can begin after brief
trust and safety testing.
Reduced wait times
-40%
With intake and eligibility automated, patient wait times can drop by 40% or more, getting your
patients needed care faster.
Extra revenue per staff
+$50K
MedFlow unlocks additional revenue and care opportunities without additional headcount or training
requirements.

## What do our customers say?

> " Einstein famously said insanity is doing the same thing over and over and expecting a different
> result. That's exactly where many clinical workflows have been stuck for years. MedFlow changes
> that by embedding smarter, proven workflows directly into the EHR so practices can scale quality,
> improve outcomes, and actually see measurable ROI without adding work. "

Aryan P. Kadivar, MD

Primary Care Physician, Kadivar Family Medicine

> " One of the most valuable things about working with MedFlow is the visibility it creates. We were
> able to stand this workflow up quickly and see it working in production almost immediately. It
> showed us how much potential automation has across the rest of our operations. "

VP Engineering

Specialty dementia practice

> " In a busy primary care practice, the biggest challenge is making sure workflows are efficient
> and that documentation is accurate every time. What we really need is efficient workflows and
> accurate charting so nothing falls through the cracks. MedFlow helps us make sure the right
> documentation and processes happen every time. "

Practice Manager

Primary care practice

[Read more customer stories ][102]

## What you get with MedFlow

MedFlow automates the busy work behind scheduling, prepping, and coordinating outpatient care so you
can focus on delivering an exceptional patient experience.

### Realtime Patient Cohorts

Drive population health operations with live patient cohorts that update automatically with
multifactorial data from your EHR, HIE, and other tools.

### Care Gap Automation

Automate actions that close care gaps and keep patients engaged. When the time is right, MedFlow
kicks off tailored, logic-powered actions.

### Seamless Tool Integration

Full bidirectional API integration with Athenahealth and leading RCM, scheduling, and engagement
tools for practice ops that just work.

### Better Care, Better Performance

MedFlow gives your EHR superpowers, so it's easy to move the needle on reimbursements now and
support performance-based contracting.

[Read more features ][103]

## Explore our connections

Live integrations with your EHR, HIE, labs, engagement tools, and much more.

Featured
athenaOne New Patient

Automatically trigger workflows whenever a new patient is added to athenaOne, ensuring seamless
onboarding and care coordination.

[Digital Cognitive Assessment]
Featured
System Digital Cognitive Assessment

Automatically create comprehensive cognitive assessments, enhancing the evaluation of cognitive
health.

[ADT Alerts Sync]
Featured
Big Sky Care Connect ADT Alerts Sync

Receive real-time alerts from Big Sky Care Connect for patient admissions, discharges, and transfers
to ensure timely follow-up care.

[Send a Message]
Featured
Kno2 Send a Message

Send secure messages and PDF documents to Kno2 recipients using the Kno2 DSM Connector, enabling
HIPAA-compliant communication with healthcare providers and patients.

[Send Fax Message]
Featured
System Send Fax Message

Send fax documents with patient data using the MedFlow Fax System, supporting PDF generation from
templates or existing files to streamline secure communication with healthcare providers.

[Create Patient Case]
Featured
Max Pulse Create Patient Case

Create a patient case for Max Pulse testing eligibility based on specific ICD-10 codes found in the
patient's conditions.

# Take your diagnostic and surgical reporting to the next level.

Powered by our Graphical Fusion Workflow Technology, Medstreaming uses structured data, coupled with
visual interactive tools, to simplify documentation—reducing the need for traditional data entry and
dictation.

## Explore Our Workflow Solutions

Learn more about how you can maximize productivity, streamline reporting, and gain meaningful
patient insights with our specialty workflow solutions.

### Hospitals and
### Health Systems

### OBLs and ASCs

The vascular workflow solution has been easy to access and has provided highly professional report
standardization for all of our hospital, office and ambulatory vascular facilities. It is
tremendously helpful to have so much data at our fingertips which greatly supports our goal in
achieving the highest level of patient care quality
Marc Glickman, M.D.Chief of Vascular Surgery, Sentara Healthcare
We consider ourselves somewhat of a unicorn because we have such a big vascular program. In
Medstreaming, we’ve found a company that has invested the time and energy to make vascular reporting
easy to complete and easy to scale. They are the right partner for our needs, no matter the setting.
Carolyn StrekDirector, Vascular Services Line, Sentara Healthcare
I’ve always felt like we were in good hands with Medstreaming. Our clinical applications lead has
always been my go-to for training. He’ll work one-on one with my management team and even a
technologist if we need him to. It’s a really good relationship.
Linda JonesDirector of Regional Vascular Services, ProMedica Health System
They’ve met all our expectations, if not exceeded them," she says. "Urgent issues are handled within
minutes, and even our non-urgent issues are handled within an hour. We couldn’t ask for a better
partner.
Linda JonesDirector of Regional Vascular Services, ProMedica Health System
Our physicians are very happy with the Medstreaming vascular reporting system. If there was a threat
of taking it away, they would really have a problem with it.
Linda JonesDirector of Regional Vascular Services, ProMedica Health System
My physicians took to the system much easier than I expected. I have not had a single question from
the physicians since they have gone live with the system.
Josh LeeDirector of Vascular Services, Premier Surgical Associates
Medstreaming has been a complete game changer for my workflow. My vascular reading time has dropped
by at least 80%, and I absolutely love the system.
Jeffrey J. Siracuse, MD, MBAChief of Vascular and Endovascular Surgery, Boston Medical Center

## The Medstreaming Advantage

## Reduce reporting times from days to hours and minutes.

Improving operational performance and clinical outcomes, while lowering costs, are top of mind for
healthcare organizations. With 100% integration with your ultrasound DICOM data and measurements,
combined with interactive sketch capabilities and macros for common interpretations, Medstreaming
helps your sonographers and physicians save time—from start to finish.

## Operate from a single system.

Leverage your existing investments with consistent image and measurement mapping, giving you the
ability to do all of your offline measurement and reporting within a single system. With over
fifteen years of experience integrating imaging modalities from multiple vendors, Medstreaming
offers a vendor neutral, multi-modality approach that streamlines your clinical workflow.

## Quickly and accurately care for patients with insights from multimedia reports.

Relying solely on text-based narrative reporting is out and multimedia reporting is in. Medstreaming
incorporates tagged images and graphical displays of quantitative data trends in reports—so
physicians can spend more time caring for patients and less time dictating and documenting.

## Increase physician productivity and satisfaction.

In the Medstreaming solution, reports are generated in real-time, as exams occur, allowing
physicians to quickly add or validate conclusions. The use of macros reduces the need for dictation
and allows for consistent reporting across the entire organization and tagged images allow
physicians to compare trends and save time searching for prior studies. Together, this creates a
clearer, more comprehensive workflow for reading physicians—leading to higher productivity and
physician satisfaction.

## Discover better workflow for your organization.

easy to complete and easy to scale. They are the right partner for our needs, no matter the setting.
Carolyn StrekDirector, Vascular Services Line, Sentara Healthcare
I’ve always felt like we were in good hands with Medstreaming. Our clinical applications lead has
always been my go-to for training. He’ll work one-on one with my management team and even a
technologist if we need him to. It’s a really good relationship.
Linda JonesDirector of Regional Vascular Services, ProMedica Health System
They’ve met all our expectations, if not exceeded them," she says. "Urgent issues are handled within
minutes, and even our non-urgent issues are handled within an hour. We couldn’t ask for a better
partner.
Linda JonesDirector of Regional Vascular Services, ProMedica Health System
Our physicians are very happy with the Medstreaming vascular reporting system. If there was a threat
of taking it away, they would really have a problem with it.
Linda JonesDirector of Regional Vascular Services, ProMedica Health System
My physicians took to the system much easier than I expected. I have not had a single question from
the physicians since they have gone live with the system.
Josh LeeDirector of Vascular Services, Premier Surgical Associates
Medstreaming has been a complete game changer for my workflow. My vascular reading time has dropped
by at least 80%, and I absolutely love the system.
Jeffrey J. Siracuse, MD, MBAChief of Vascular and Endovascular Surgery, Boston Medical Center

## The Medstreaming Advantage

## Reduce reporting times from days to hours and minutes.

Improving operational performance and clinical outcomes, while lowering costs, are top of mind for
healthcare organizations. With 100% integration with your ultrasound DICOM data and measurements,
combined with interactive sketch capabilities and macros for common interpretations, Medstreaming
helps your sonographers and physicians save time—from start to finish.

## Operate from a single system.

Leverage your existing investments with consistent image and measurement mapping, giving you the
ability to do all of your offline measurement and reporting within a single system. With over
fifteen years of experience integrating imaging modalities from multiple vendors, Medstreaming
offers a vendor neutral, multi-modality approach that streamlines your clinical workflow.

## Quickly and accurately care for patients with insights from multimedia reports.

Relying solely on text-based narrative reporting is out and multimedia reporting is in. Medstreaming
incorporates tagged images and graphical displays of quantitative data trends in reports—so
physicians can spend more time caring for patients and less time dictating and documenting.

## Increase physician productivity and satisfaction.

In the Medstreaming solution, reports are generated in real-time, as exams occur, allowing
physicians to quickly add or validate conclusions. The use of macros reduces the need for dictation
and allows for consistent reporting across the entire organization and tagged images allow
physicians to compare trends and save time searching for prior studies. Together, this creates a
clearer, more comprehensive workflow for reading physicians—leading to higher productivity and
physician satisfaction.

OmniLife Health is dedicated to helping clinicians and patients achieve optimal health outcomes with
purpose-built tools that simplify complex care pathways.

OmniLife Health’s flagship clinical workflow automation platform connects care teams throughout the
complex care journey, digitizing all the critical care conversations happening outside the EHR.

#### Empower Care Teams

Increase productivity and reduce the impact of staffing shortages.

#### Create Structure

#### Optimize Performance and Outcomes

Drive process improvements and optimize billing.

We enter into contracts with companies every day. Each of those contracts was with something with
legal personality – almost always a "legal entity". Yet too often we're ignorant of them and who is
behind them, with all the attendant risks that brings.

Whether you're in business, government, journalism, activism, research or a consumer — [our
goal][39] is to help you better understand the companies you deal with.

Search the world’s largest open legal-entity database or plug the data direct into your applications

  Pick the cloud you want to use.
  
  Get the same low price everywhere.

  Google Gemini, Meta Llama, OpenAI ChatGPT, xAI Grok, and more . . .

  Platform's Data Catalog

  An end-to-end Integrated Development Environment for building any type of AI Application – chat,
  multistep agents, transactions, workflows – on all your data

  Put the entire Oracle Cloud inside your data center. Cloud@Customer includes every Oracle
  infrastructure service and application. Your data and network traffic stay secure and private
  inside your data center and behind your firewall.
  
  **Enable AI on your Private Data**
  
  Now you can do AI inferencing and multistep reasoning on your private data while keeping that data
  private.
  
  [Learn more][27]

  [Learn more][23]
* ## AI Data Platform
  
  **AI Models in Oracle Cloud**
  
  Google Gemini, Meta Llama, OpenAI ChatGPT, xAI Grok, and more . . .
  
  **AI Data Catalog**
  
  Unifies all your private structured and unstructured data without moving it – by using the AI Data
  Platform's Data Catalog
  
  [Get started with AI Data Catalog][24]
  
  **AI Data Platform Workbench**
  
  An end-to-end Integrated Development Environment for building any type of AI Application – chat,
  multistep agents, transactions, workflows – on all your data
  
  [Get started with AI Data Platform Workbench][25]
  
  [Learn More][26]
  [AI Data Platform with Multimodal AI models, Public Data and Private Data Lakehouse]
  
  ### AI models reason on private data
  
  All private data unified in data catalog
* [Cloud@Customer]
  
  ### All OCI Services in 3 Racks
  
  Installed in your data center from $250,000 per month
  
  ## Cloud@Customer
  
  **All OCI Services and Applications**
  
  Put the entire Oracle Cloud inside your data center. Cloud@Customer includes every Oracle
  infrastructure service and application. Your data and network traffic stay secure and private
  inside your data center and behind your firewall.
  
  **Enable AI on your Private Data**
  
  Now you can do AI inferencing and multistep reasoning on your private data while keeping that data
  private.
  
  [Learn more][27]
* ## Fusion Applications
  
  Fusion is the only application suite that brings AI to every aspect of your business:
  
  **ERP Applications**
  
  [Finance and Accounting][28]
  [Supply Chain and Manufacturing][29]
  
  **HCM Applications**
  
  [Human Resources][30]
  [Payroll][31]
  
  **Customer Experience**
  
  [Marketing][32]
  [Sales][33]
  [Service][34]
  
  [Learn more][35]
  [Fusion Application Suite]
  
  ### DHL Supply Chain runs on Oracle Fusion
  
  Modernizes back-office operations and enables innovation
* [Health Application Suite]
  
  ### Digital Ambulance
  
  Patients are continually monitored in transit by hospital ER doctors
  
  ## Health Application Suite
  
  Oracle Health is the first of our Application Suites to be entirely rebuilt as a set of AI Agents
  connected by workflows. The Oracle Health Suite includes applications for managing the entire
  healthcare ecosystem including providers: ambulatory clinics, acute care
  hospitals; payers: insurance companies, governments;  and public health and regulatory agencies.
  
  **Healthcare Applications**
  
  Ambulatory Care System for Clinics
  Acute Care System for Hospitals
  Clinical and Financial Operations
  Payer Preauthorization System
  
  **Healthcare Technology Foundation**
  
  Oracle Cloud Infrastructure
  AI Data Platform
  Oracle AI Database
  
  [Learn more][36]
* ## Industry Specific Applications
  
  Oracle provides industry specific cloud application suites for more than two dozen industries.
  These are modern SaaS applications with built-in AI, machine learning, and analytics. These
  industry applications integrate seamlessly with core business functions in Fusion ERP, HCM, Supply
  Chain, Finance, and Customer Experience. Here are a few examples:
  
  **Banking Suite**
  
  Includes core banking, anti-money laundering, risk management, compliance, and AI analytics.
  
  **Construction and Engineering**
  
  Includes project management, procurement, supplier analytics, subcontractor payments, cost
  controls, and more.
  
  **Retail Suite**
  
  Includes merchandising, multistore inventory management, omnichannel demand forecasting, etc.

### Featured Products - See our favorites

[[Clinical nucleic acid extraction, in tune with your lab’s rhythm]][108]

##### [Clinical nucleic acid extraction, in tune with your lab’s rhythm][109]

Introducing QIAsymphony Connect – coming soon – the next generation of automated IVD nucleic acid
extraction. Built on the trusted QIAsymphony SP platform, it combines proven performance with
enhanced traceability, high nucleic acid yields and connectivity for modern clinical labs.
[See QIAsymphony Connect][110]
[[Streamline your clinical PCR workflows with QIAcuityDx]][111]

##### [Streamline your clinical PCR workflows with QIAcuityDx][112]

QIAcuityDx is a fully automated digital PCR system tailored for IVD applications. It enhances
diagnostic precision and operational efficiency by reducing hands-on time and ensuring accurate
detection and quantification of important genetic variations.
[Explore QIAcuityDx][113]
[[Discover the eco-friendlier alternative to our most popular nucleic acid extraction kits]][114]

##### [Discover the eco-friendlier alternative to our most popular nucleic acid extraction
##### kits][115]

Make your lab more sustainable with our QIAwave kits, now both in 50 and 250 sample sizes. The
QIAwave kits use less plastic and cardboard compared to our standard kits with reusable waste tubes
made from 100% recycled plastic.
[See for yourself][116]
[[Meet the NEW TissueLyser III]][117]

##### [Meet the NEW TissueLyser III][118]

Ensure successful downstream DNA and RNA analysis from the start by effectively lysing your
challenging samples with the TissueLyser III.  Get one for your lab today.
[View instrument][119]
[[QIAseq xHYB Viral and Bacterial Panels: High-quality targeted viral and bacterial NGS]][120]

##### [QIAseq xHYB Viral and Bacterial Panels: High-quality targeted viral and bacterial NGS][121]

Harness the power of hybrid capture technology for high-sensitivity detection and sequencing of
respiratory viruses, sexually transmitted pathogens, bacterial AMR genes and adventitious agents.
[Product details][122]
[[Fast-track your RNA-seq with QIAseq FastSelect RNA Library Kits]][123]

##### [Fast-track your RNA-seq with QIAseq FastSelect RNA Library Kits][124]

Go from sample to libraries in <5 hours with a fast and convenient solution that incorporates rRNA
removal, library prep and data analysis.
[Go to product][125]
[[Study the spread of mpox with the QIAstat-Dx Viral Vesicular Panel]][126]

##### [Study the spread of mpox with the QIAstat-Dx Viral Vesicular Panel][127]

Enhance your research and surveillance efforts of the mpox virus with our QIAstat-Dx Viral Vesicular
Panel. With seven viral targets included, you can easily differentiate nucleic acids from multiple
viral pathogens.
[Technical overview][128]
[[Work smarter with the QIAxcel Connect gel electrophoresis system]][129]

##### [Work smarter with the QIAxcel Connect gel electrophoresis system][130]

Ready-to-use, easy-to-replace gel cartridges. High resolution, high sensitivity. Process up to 96
samples in a single run. All this power and convenience – in a single gel electrophoresis
instrument.
[Product info][131]
[[QIAcuity dPCR System: Fast, accessible and reliable digital PCR]][132]

##### [QIAcuity dPCR System: Fast, accessible and reliable digital PCR][133]

Three things every laboratory deserves. And it is qPCR-like but only better. So, treat your research
to a fully integrated and scalable nanoplate-based digital PCR system, delivering absolute answers
from your samples in two hours.
[Discover more][134]

Rauland
A respected leader in the design, manufacturing and delivery of critical and advanced
communications, workflow and life-safety solutions for healthcare and education worldwide.
[Learn More][28]

Responder

Designed for healthcare environments, Rauland’s clinical communication system helps hospitals manage
workflows and coordinate care across units. With integrated devices and software, it supports
connections among caregivers, patients, and hospital systems.

[Learn More][29]

Telecenter

Strengthen district-wide communication with Telecenter—Rauland’s scalable, IP-based solution for
everyday operations and emergency response. Connect classrooms, offices, and campuses through a
unified system built for speed, reliability, and safety.

[Learn More][30]

Integrations

Health systems benefit from reduced complexity of managing multiple technologies and healthcare
teams. The Rauland VIP Program allows participating vendors to connect devices, software, and
platforms with Rauland solutions, ensuring interoperability across the healthcare ecosystem.

[Learn More][31]

# Transforming Care and Learning Through Smart Communication Technology

Rauland delivers advanced communication and workflow solutions that enhance safety, efficiency, and
responsiveness across hospitals and schools.

 

Our smart, interoperable platforms connect teams, streamline critical processes, and support better
outcomes for patients, staff, and students. By unifying essential communication pathways, we empower
organizations to operate with greater clarity, coordination, and confidence.

Acute CareAmbulatory Surgery CentersLong Term CareGovernment HealthcareEducation
Acute Care

## Acute Care

## Smarter Communication & Workflows for Complex Hospital Environments 

Used by hospitals across the globe, Rauland is the trusted leader in advanced clinical
communications and workflow solutions in dynamic acute care settings. The Responder nurse call
platform supports improved staffing models, enhanced clinician satisfaction and technology
interoperability to create a sharper focus on timely, efficient responses to patient needs.

[Learn More][32]
Ambulatory Surgery Centers

## Ambulatory Surgery Centers

## Coordinated Outpatient Surgical Care 

The Responder^{®} 5000 platform supports high-volume, fast-turnaround surgical care with features
like pre-op coordination, intra-procedure alerts, and discharge workflows. Ambulatory surgery
centers utilize Rauland technologies to enhance clinical workflows, help improve patient throughput,
and boost operational efficiencies.

[Learn More][33]
Long Term Care

## Long Term Care

## Efficient, Compassionate Long-Term Care

Utilized by long-term care and assisted living providers worldwide, Rauland delivers communication
technology solutions that help enhance resident safety and streamline operations. Responder 5000
supports efficient care environments through proactive alerts, fall risk identification and tools to
bolster improved communication and task management.

[Learn More][34]
Government Healthcare

## Government Healthcare

## Secure, Streamlined Government Healthcare

Leveraged by government healthcare institutions nationwide, Rauland delivers nurse call and
analytics solutions that enhance safety, streamline operations, and unify communication for U.S.
government healthcare facilities. Responder Enterprise is engineered to comply with FIPS 140-2 and
FIPS 140-3 standards, offering a centralized architecture and robust data security to address the
latest cybersecurity requirements.

[Learn More][35]

## Safer, Smarter Schools 

Trusted by schools for over 80 years, Rauland serves K-12 educational institutions with solutions
that enhance safety, streamline operations, and unify communication. The Telecenter^{®} system
features emergency response tools, visual messaging, and touch screen workflow automation.

[Learn More][36]

Providing strategic consulting, financing, analytic, and tech-enabled solutions that improve access,
quality, and outcomes for underserved communities nationwide.

With a singular focus on healthcare, we deliver comprehensive solutions and services to help our
clients navigate an ever-changing regulatory landscape. Together with our clients, we help design,
fund, implement, and optimize sustainable programs that deliver maximum impact to underserved
communities.

At Sellers Dorsey, we believe everyone deserves access to quality, compassionate care. We partner

expertise — from Medicaid directors to healthcare executives — with cutting-edge data analytics and
visualization, delivering tailored strategies and proven solutions that drive impact.

# Celebrating 170 years

A legacy of healthcare innovation. A future without limits.

Discover our story

# Life Unlimited

Smith+Nephew is a portfolio medical technology company focused on the repair, regeneration and
replacement of soft and hard tissue. We exist to restore people's bodies and their self-belief by
using technology to take the limits off living.

[Sports Medicine]

# Sports Medicine

From elite athletes to weekend warriors, everyone wants to get back to doing what they love after a
sporting injury. With our leading-edge technology, we help patients get back to living a Life
Unlimited.

Explore sports medicine

# Ultimate victory

Hear the story of how our technology, in the hands of a leading surgeon, helped Tom Aspinall recover
from a career-threatening injury to become the UFC world heavyweight champion.

Explore Tom Aspinall's story
