## Smith+Nephew's top products

[ALLEVYN-LIFE-HERO-1-840x840-PX.png]

#### ALLEVYN^{◊} LIFE Foam Dressings

In a climate of growing expectations and budget restrictions,^{1-3} ALLEVYN LIFE Dressings may help
improve efficiency and patient satisfaction in community wound care,^{*4-7 }and have been shown to
support pressure injury prevention protocols^{8,9}
[ View product ][80]
[REGENETEN implant on RCR image from animation]

#### REGENETEN^{◊} Bioinductive Implant

Bioinductive collagen scaffold for tendon repair.^{1-3} Resorbed and replaced by new tendon-like
tissue within 6 months to support tendon healing.1,2,4-8
[ View product ][81]
[Hero 1 CORI Surgical System.png]

#### CORI^{◊} Surgical System

Combine your skill with handheld robotics and digital surgery applications across a range of joint
arthroplasty indications. Experience the power of one platform.
[ View product ][82]
[Tula Tympanostomy Kit]

#### Tula^{®} Tympanostomy System

An in-office alternative to traditional tympanostomy using a revolutionary, local anesthesia system
and an automated, 1-click tube delivery device.^{1,2}
[ View product ][83]
[Close up of EDGE, front]

#### RENASYS^{◊} EDGE Negative Pressure Wound Therapy System

The latest evolution in powerful RENASYS tNPWT features an improved user interface for enhanced
intuitiveness and simplicity, with a durable pump built to offer maintenance-free use^{*1-3}
[ View product ][84]
[41813 CARTIHEAL Product Page Hero Image V2]

#### CARTIHEAL^{◊} AGILI-C^{◊} Cartilage Repair Implant

A single-stage, off-the-shelf solution for knee cartilage and osteochondral defects, with or without
mild to moderate osteoarthritis (KL 0-3) comprised of a proprietary biomaterial that is porous and
biocompatible.
[ View product ][85]
[JOURNEYII_BCS_ROX_RoundPatella_AngledView_onWhite.png]

#### JOURNEY II^{◊} ROX^{◊} Total Knee Solution with CONCELOC^{◊} and OXINIUM^{◊} Technologies

Combining cemented and cementless technologies for a reverse hybrid approach, we bring to the stage
our latest and greatest in joint reconstruction
[ View product ][86]
[COR22-33747-V1-ProjectsAlchemy-AirwayMgmt-Hero-1122.png]

#### COBLATION^{◊} Technology for Airway Management

Designed for precise tissue removal^{1-5 }with a low thermal profile⁶
[ View product ][87]

## Transforming lives

Learn how our history and our passion drive us to strengthen, accelerate and transform the future of
medical technology

## Wound Care

Smith+Nephew's Wound Care (Advanced Wound Management) portfolio provides comprehensive solutions to
meet broad and complex clinical needs and to help healthcare professionals reduce the human and
economic consequences of wounds.

[GettyImages-1448442087-CUT-OUT-SHAPE.png]

### Wound care indications

Acute, chronic and surgical wound indications, covering key considerations and common aetiologies
(such as inflammation, trauma or vascular deficiency) to help you build a treatment or prevention
plan to restore tissue integrity, reduce complications and promote healing.

[ View all ][88]

### Wound care products

A range of wound care products for targeted intervention on acute, chronic and surgical wounds based
on your patient’s needs and clinical strategy. Solutions range from core products for exudate
management and compression, through to advanced therapies for non-healing wounds and prevention of
infection via antimicrobial barriers.

[ View all ][89]

## Sports Medicine

From elite athletes to weekend warriors, everyone wants to get back to doing what they love after a
sporting injury. With our leading-edge technology, we help patients get back to living a Life
Unlimited.

[ Explore sports medicine ][90]
[Homepage Sports Medicine business unit teaser]

## Orthopaedic Reconstruction

Smith+Nephew's Orthopaedics portfolio includes an innovative range of hip and knee implants used to
replace diseased, damaged or worn joints, robotics-assisted and enabling technologies, and services
that empower surgeons. It also includes trauma products used to stabilise severe fractures and
correct bone deformities.

## Smith+Nephew's top products

[ALLEVYN-LIFE-HERO-1-840x840-PX.png]

#### ALLEVYN^{◊} LIFE Foam Dressings

In a climate of growing expectations and budget restrictions,^{1-3} ALLEVYN LIFE Dressings may help
improve efficiency and patient satisfaction in community wound care,^{*4-7 }and have been shown to
support pressure injury prevention protocols^{8,9}
[ View product ][80]
[REGENETEN implant on RCR image from animation]

#### REGENETEN^{◊} Bioinductive Implant

Bioinductive collagen scaffold for tendon repair.^{1-3} Resorbed and replaced by new tendon-like
tissue within 6 months to support tendon healing.1,2,4-8
[ View product ][81]
[Hero 1 CORI Surgical System.png]

#### CORI^{◊} Surgical System

Combine your skill with handheld robotics and digital surgery applications across a range of joint
arthroplasty indications. Experience the power of one platform.
[ View product ][82]
[Tula Tympanostomy Kit]

#### Tula^{®} Tympanostomy System

An in-office alternative to traditional tympanostomy using a revolutionary, local anesthesia system
and an automated, 1-click tube delivery device.^{1,2}
[ View product ][83]
[Close up of EDGE, front]

#### RENASYS^{◊} EDGE Negative Pressure Wound Therapy System

The latest evolution in powerful RENASYS tNPWT features an improved user interface for enhanced
intuitiveness and simplicity, with a durable pump built to offer maintenance-free use^{*1-3}
[ View product ][84]
[41813 CARTIHEAL Product Page Hero Image V2]

#### CARTIHEAL^{◊} AGILI-C^{◊} Cartilage Repair Implant

A single-stage, off-the-shelf solution for knee cartilage and osteochondral defects, with or without
mild to moderate osteoarthritis (KL 0-3) comprised of a proprietary biomaterial that is porous and
biocompatible.
[ View product ][85]
[JOURNEYII_BCS_ROX_RoundPatella_AngledView_onWhite.png]

#### JOURNEY II^{◊} ROX^{◊} Total Knee Solution with CONCELOC^{◊} and OXINIUM^{◊} Technologies

Combining cemented and cementless technologies for a reverse hybrid approach, we bring to the stage
our latest and greatest in joint reconstruction
[ View product ][86]
[COR22-33747-V1-ProjectsAlchemy-AirwayMgmt-Hero-1122.png]

#### COBLATION^{◊} Technology for Airway Management

Designed for precise tissue removal^{1-5 }with a low thermal profile⁶
[ View product ][87]

Learn how our history and our passion drive us to strengthen, accelerate and transform the future of

## Wound Care

Smith+Nephew's Wound Care (Advanced Wound Management) portfolio provides comprehensive solutions to
meet broad and complex clinical needs and to help healthcare professionals reduce the human and
economic consequences of wounds.

[GettyImages-1448442087-CUT-OUT-SHAPE.png]

### Wound care indications

Acute, chronic and surgical wound indications, covering key considerations and common aetiologies
(such as inflammation, trauma or vascular deficiency) to help you build a treatment or prevention
plan to restore tissue integrity, reduce complications and promote healing.

[ View all ][88]

### Wound care products

A range of wound care products for targeted intervention on acute, chronic and surgical wounds based
on your patient’s needs and clinical strategy. Solutions range from core products for exudate
management and compression, through to advanced therapies for non-healing wounds and prevention of
infection via antimicrobial barriers.

[ View all ][89]

## Sports Medicine

From elite athletes to weekend warriors, everyone wants to get back to doing what they love after a
sporting injury. With our leading-edge technology, we help patients get back to living a Life
Unlimited.

[ Explore sports medicine ][90]
[Homepage Sports Medicine business unit teaser]

## Orthopaedic Reconstruction

Smith+Nephew's Orthopaedics portfolio includes an innovative range of hip and knee implants used to
replace diseased, damaged or worn joints, robotics-assisted and enabling technologies, and services
that empower surgeons. It also includes trauma products used to stabilise severe fractures and
correct bone deformities.

#### RIGHT PATIENT. RIGHT CARE SETTING. EVERY TIME.

# Move patients forward

Tennr is an agentic patient orchestration platform built for policy-grade decisioning and patient
flow at scale. Tennr helps providers navigate patients through complex payer requirements, countless
engagements, and every step in between.

[Learn More][9]

#### AT A GLANCE

## With Tennr, patients flow

Make intelligent operational decisions through every patient order, referral, or complex care
journey. Made possible by proprietary models trained on the largest dataset of service-to-payer
criteria mappings.

#### THE BOTTOM LINE

## No delays. Fewer denials. Optimal patient journeys.

Tennr intelligently processes and routes patients so high-performing healthcare operations can route
to the right care, in the right setting, every time.

### Move patients to the right places

Eliminate the operational friction that slows progression between consults, diagnostics,
authorizations, and scheduling.

### Slash first-pass denials

Turn a library of payer criteria into automatic operational decisions. Assemble proof, prioritize
care plans, and avoid revenue loss.

### Close the loop in care coordination

Coordinate patients, providers, and payers without endless manual follow-up calls or touch points.

[Explore the Product][10]

#### WHO WE WORK WITH

## Trusted nationwide

From national networks to independent providers, we power operations and millions of care pathways
each month.

#### KEEP PATIENTS MOVING

## Patient flow, optimized

Tennr keeps your patients moving through their care journeys without creating work for your team,
creating clarity and improving your cash flows at the same time.

Tennr automatically classifies and routes patient data from any source—fax, portal, internal
order—into the right operational workflows.

Wherever charts and orders need to reflect changes, they'll be automatically updated.

Tennr can check eligibility, investigate benefits over the phone, and submit prior authorizations.

Your patients' authorization status and medical necessity criteria will directly drive Tennr's
recommendations.

Finally, Tennr uses all of the data it touches to intelligently drive patient routing decisions,
unblock what’s stuck, and get you paid faster.

#### Testimonials

## What our customers say

They're improving quality, moving faster, and freeing up their teams. Here's what they have to say:

“With Tennr, we’re able to do things so much faster, and it's just huge. It’s been a game changer.
We’re able to reach out to patients so much faster.”

[Alyssa Jakubowski - Revenue Cycle and Compliance Manager at NEB Medical]

Alyssa Jakubowski
Revenue Cycle and Compliance Manager at NEB Medical

“I call it the 'Tennr effect.' For every action, there's a reaction. As we speed things up at the
front of the time, it's going to have downstream effects.”

[Chip Holland - President of Total Sleep Management]

Chip Holland
President of Total Sleep Management

“We hit 260 faxes in one day… and were able to manage it.”

[Amy Willis - Director of Complex Rehab at King Drug]

Amy Willis
Director of Complex Rehab at King Drug

#### OPERATIONAL EXCELLENCE AT SCALE

## Tennr sets a new standard for healthcare ops

Leading providers move faster, improve quality, and drive revenue with less effort.
[GET STARTED][11]
Patient data that flows on autopilot

Patient care starts with unstructured documentation. Tennr pulls data from faxes, charts, and
insurance plans faster than your best intake specialist, and can handle that volume without manual
intervention.

Information to complete every care journey

Missing documentation is the #1 reason patients stall. Tennr identifies what’s missing for the
specific patient and service, requests it from the right party, and tracks it through completion.



Intelligent insurance decisioning

Select the correct payer and plan every time. Identify coverage changes early. Re-verify patients
automatically. Tennr ensures active coverage is confirmed before care is scheduled.

Integrated payer interactions

No more hours and hours spent obtaining a successful prior authorization. We've got you covered for
all submissions and tracking across benefit types.

A control tower to route patients

See which patients are stuck. See what can move today. See what impacts value-based care. Tennr
provides real-time visibility into operational bottlenecks and prioritizes work that unlocks better
care and cash flow.

#### CASE STUDIES

authorizations, and scheduling.

care plans, and avoid revenue loss.

Coordinate patients, providers, and payers without endless manual follow-up calls or touch points.
